scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --env local --local --port 3000
scripts.cloud:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply auditsphere-staging --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.cloud:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply auditsphere-production --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.cloud:r2-archive-locks:apply:staging: npm run cloud:r2-archive-locks:generate && tsx tools/apply-r2-archive-lock-rules.ts --environment staging
scripts.cloud:r2-archive-locks:apply:production: npm run cloud:r2-archive-locks:generate && tsx tools/apply-r2-archive-lock-rules.ts --environment production
scripts.cloud:deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run cloud:migrate:staging && npm run cloud:r2-archive-locks:apply:staging && wrangler deploy --config worker/emailProvider/wrangler.jsonc --env staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
